physical.title: dress
physical.summary: Baluchi-style small child's dress (dishdasha or pashk) made of white cotton with a printed pink pattern. The dress gathers at either side of the waist and, like other Baluchi-style dresses, is characterised by a long A-shaped pocket (pado pandohl) stitched on the front of the skirt to the top of the hem. The pocket is open along one of the short edges. The dress is hand-embroidered with colourful cross-stitched bands on the front and back, including the long pocket, shoulders and sleeve cuffs. The remants of the embroidery patterns that were first inked onto the fabric using wood-block stamps as a guide for the embroiderer are evident around the front of the dress. Can be worn with or without matching baggy trousers (sirwal).

physical.title: dress
physical.summary: Baluchi-style woman's long-sleeve dress (dishdasha or pashk) made of turquoise-green satin silk that falls just below the knee; part of a three-piece outfit. The dress gathers at either side of the waist and, like other Baluchi-style dresses, is characterised by a long A-shaped pocket (pado pandohl) stitched on the front of the skirt below the chest panel (jig) to the top of the hem. The pocket is open along one of the short edges. The dress is densely hand-embroidered with colourful bands, diamond-shapes and snowflake patterns on the chest panel, long front pocket and sleeve cuffs, mainly in box-stitch. Colourful embroidered snowflake patterns are also scattered throughout the dress on the front and back. Worn with matching baggy silk trousers (sirwal, 2011,6003.44b) and silk head-shawl (shadar) (2011,6003.44c).

physical.title: trousers
physical.summary: Baluchi-style woman's baggy trousers (sirwal) made of turquoise-green satin silk; part of a three-piece outfit. The trousers have an elasticated waist and wide ankles that cover the heels when worn. The trouser-cuffs are worked in similar box-stitched hand-embroidery as the matching dress (dishdasha or pashk, 2011,6003.44a) and head-shawl (shadar) (2011,6003.44c), with colourful bands, diamond-shapes and snowflake patterns reaching calf-height.
